page: Google Cloud Platform n4-highmem-32 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the n4 family. It features 32 vCPUs mapped to 16 physical Intel cores with hyperthreading enabled, providing a dedicated CPU allocation. The instance is configured with 256 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. It operates on the x86_64 architecture and includes a 260 MB L3 cache. No local storage or GPUs are bundled with this instance type.

The underlying Intel processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and int8 operations, alongside cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. In benchmark testing, the instance demonstrates strong performance in memory bandwidth, achieving 208.51 GB/sec for large-block read-only operations and 99.59 GB/sec for large-block write operations, both placing in the top 25% tier. Image processing and static web serving throughput also register in the top 25% tier, with web throughput reaching 44.59 GB/sec.

Other computational benchmarks, such as Geekbench multi-core and Passmark CPU tests, fall within the average range. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes this instance qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. It is well-suited for medium-scale database hosting, memory-cached web serving, enterprise application backends, and lightweight LLM inference tasks.
